title: Zephyr: CoAP message parse/serialize
notes: Implemented allocation-free RFC 7252 message codec in coap_codec.c/.h with zero-copy parse, canonical bounded serialization, token/options/payload handling, extended delta/length forms, cumulative-option overflow checks, malformed/truncated/reserved rejection, and failure atomicity. Added shared coap_messages.json vector consumer plus focused edge tests in lichen/tests/coap_codec and narrow CoAP build wiring. Validation: host Apple clang ASan/UBSan ctest 1/1 PASS; local Zephyr 4.1 qemu_x86 4/4 PASS (used approved verification-only -Wno-error=duplicated-branches for unrelated Zephyr logging macro warning; production warnings remained fatal); Python CoAP vector/property scope 60 passed, 1 skipped, 3 expected xfailed; Rust coap_rfc_vectors 3/3 PASS with unique target dir; ruff clean; scoped git diff --check clean. Pinned Zephyr 3.7 clone is unavailable locally per AGENTS, so the allowed Zephyr 4.1 smoke gate was used.
close_reason: RFC 7252 codec and canonical vector/edge coverage implemented; all scoped host, QEMU, Python, and Rust validation passed.
